bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Updates Treasury Assets to $9.6 Billion
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies reported total treasury assets of $9.6 billion as of June 7, 2026, including 5.54 million ETH and 204 Bitcoin.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Deposits Additional Assets to Coinbase Prime
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock has transferred 3,300 Bitcoin and 15,095 Ethereum to its accounts on the Coinbase Prime institutional platform.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitdeer Maintains Zero Bitcoin Treasury Policy with Sale of 205.3 BTC
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group has sold 205.3 BTC, representing its total production for the week, to maintain its zero-balance Bitcoin treasury policy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Sterling Digital Plc Enters Gas Purchase Agreement for Bitcoin Mining Operations
bitcoin_articles.summary: Sterling Digital Plc has signed a five-year gas purchase agreement with a US supplier to power its Bitcoin mining operations in West Texas.
